name: Hasami Chinami
source:
"Ugh, what's so tacky? ...If you want, I can fix it myself?”

Despite her young age, she is a super high school level hair designer who has won the most in national beauty contests. There is no hairstyle that is impossible for her like that.

Perhaps because of the reaction of those around her, she shows an obsession with others and her own appearance. The person she hates the most in the world is a 'cheeky person'.

Even her own hairstyle changes once a day, giving off energy (dyeing and length are free).
She has a tsundere temperament, and even if she says harsh words, she gives advice on what kind of hairstyle will suit others, and even cuts it herself (...shows the end of tsundere).
